checks.text: With the app loaded and no input, the input pane is empty, the output pane is empty, and the select labelled "Encoding" shows "Base64".
Typing "Hello" in the input pane and selecting "Base64" in the select labelled "Encoding" shows "SGVsbG8=" in the output pane.
Typing "SGVsbG8=" in the input pane and selecting "Base64" in the select labelled "Encoding" shows "Hello" in the output pane.
Typing "Hello" in the input pane and selecting "Hex" in the select labelled "Encoding" shows "48656c6c6f" in the output pane.
Typing "48656c6c6f" in the input pane and selecting "Hex" in the select labelled "Encoding" shows "Hello" in the output pane.
Typing "Hello World" in the input pane and selecting "URL-safe Base64" in the select labelled "Encoding" shows "SGVsbG8gV29ybGQ=" in the output pane.
Clicking the button labelled "Copy" when the output pane contains "SGVsbG8=" shows the tooltip "Copied" for 2 seconds and the clipboard contains "SGVsbG8=".
After typing "Test" in the input pane and selecting "Base64", clicking the button labelled "Swap" moves "VGVzdA==" to the input pane and "Test" to the output pane, with the encoding still "Base64".
Reload keeps the last conversion: after typing "Persist" in the input pane and selecting "Base64", reloading the page shows "Persist" in the input pane and "UGVyc2lzdA==" in the output pane.
